Xiamen厦门

Island city, Taiwanese and Southeast Asian ties, and a strong school reputation.

Median asking
¥35k–62k/m²
Gross yield
1.8%–2.4%
Purchase cap
One self-use home
Land term
70 years, residential

Xiamen is a compact island city with a mild climate, a long history of overseas Chinese and Taiwanese investment, and a reputation for well-run schools that supports premium pricing.

Foreign demand is small but includes buyers with family or business ties to Taiwan, Southeast Asia and the diaspora, rather than corporate postings.

Can a foreigner buy here?

One self-use home, one year of work or study in Xiamen, purchase inside the city, valid residence permit and employment proof. Expect careful checks given the cross-strait context.

Siming island apartments dominate; Jimei across the bridge offers newer stock at lower prices.

Before you view anything here

The paragraph above is a summary, not an answer. City practice is applied at district level and changes without much notice.

Take it to the counter: ask the district housing bureau to confirm your eligibility in writing, using the script in how to verify.

How to check it

Where to live

Districts that work for foreign buyers

Not every district is workable at every stage. These are the ones with the schools, services and resale liquidity foreigners actually need.

Siming思明

The island core: Gulangyu views, best schools, highest prices, tightest supply.

Huli湖里

Older island district, better value, strong local rental demand.

Jimei集美

Across the bridge: university district, newer apartments, lower entry price.

Haicang海沧

Suburban mainland side; large units, weak liquidity.

The market

How Xiamen actually trades

Island supply is genuinely constrained, which supports prices. Off-island supply is abundant, which does not.

Living here

Settling in

Mild winters, sea access, and a small but functional international school scene. Typhoon season is real between July and September.

Know before you offer

Three risks in this market

  • Off-island oversupply weakens resale.
  • Typhoon and humidity exposure for older buildings.
  • Small English-speaking professional market.

Best suited to

Buyers with regional family ties who want a mild-climate island base.

Structure of a deal

What a purchase in Xiamen actually looks like

Price is the last thing that decides the outcome. These four decide it first, and every one of them can be checked before you sign anything.

Who is on the other side

Demand comes from families with Taiwan, Southeast Asian and diaspora ties, plus local upgraders. It is not a corporate posting market, so the pool is relationship-driven and smaller than the price suggests.

What actually trades

The island is genuinely constrained, which supports prices; the mainland side is abundant, which does not. The bridge is not a small detail, because it separates two different liquidity regimes.

What is normal to negotiate

On the island, stock sells close to asking and the levers are condition and timing. Off-island, negotiate hard and check how much of the surrounding supply is still unsold by the developer.

What your exit looks like

Off-island resale is weak, and typhoon-season maintenance costs are real rather than theoretical. If you could not sell within a year of wanting to, you have bought a liability with a sea view.
